FORM NO. 8
50M-1-40

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
Section 1, Special Branch, Station,
REPORT                        Date March 13. 19 40.

Subject (in full) C. J. Rumkin.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev        Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

Mr. Constantin John RUMKIN, age about 55,
naturalized British subject of Russian origin, was
connected with Shanghai Milk Supply Company, Ltd., 145
Tunsin Road, as manager from 1935 to 1939, when he is
reported to have retired from business.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police records
concerning this person.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号...........
特务科第1股，巡捕房，
报告                        日期 1940年3月13日。

事由（全称） C. J. Rumkin。

制作人：副督察普罗科菲耶夫        呈送人：梅森警司。

康斯坦丁·约翰·鲁姆金（Constantin John RUMKIN）先生，年龄约55岁，
俄裔归化英国臣民，自1935年至1939年间与天津路145号上海牛奶供应有限公司（Shanghai Milk Supply Company, Ltd.）有关联，担任经理职务，据报其于该时退休停业。
工部局警务处档案中并无关于此人的记录。

Is leaving Shanghai shortly on a

pages.en:
March 8th, 1940.

SECRET

Is anything known of a Russian born
naturalized British subject named CONSTANTINE
JOHN RUNKIN who recently arrived in Singapore.
He was supposed to have been connected with a
dairy whilst in Shanghai.

"Y"

1940年3月8日。

秘密

是否有人了解一名名为康斯坦丁·
约翰·伦金（CONSTANTINE JOHN RUNKIN）的俄裔
归化英国臣民的情况，此人最近抵达新加坡。
据悉他在上海期间曾与一家乳品公司有关联。

“Y”
